title.zh: Max 一对一导师形象与声音选择
title.en: Max one-to-one tutor portrait and voice selection

purpose.zh: 让学生在进入实时对话前选择更亲切的 AI 导师形象和声音，并在下次会话沿用自己的选择。
purpose.en: Let learners select a personable AI tutor portrait and voice before a live conversation, preserving their choices for future calls.

zh: 三位 AI 生成的虚构导师人像可选；画面按导师说话状态作轻微动态反馈，不声称是真人视频或唇形同步。
GPT-Live 提供四种可选声音；声音在下一次新连接时生效，学习者可随时以自己的语言提问或要求导师切换回答语言。
形象和声音保存在现有 Max 导师会话中，按登录用户隔离；通话期间不可修改。
en: Choose among three AI-generated fictional tutor portraits with subtle speaking-state motion, without claiming human video or lip sync.
Choose one of four GPT-Live voices for the next connection; learners may speak in their own language or ask the tutor to switch reply language.
Save portrait and voice in the existing Max tutor session per signed-in learner, with changes locked during calls.

zh: Max 一对一实时导师、导师偏好接口和 D1 会话表；支付、订阅价格、每日额度不变。
en: Max one-to-one live tutor, preferences API and D1 session table; checkout, subscription prices and daily allowances remain unchanged.

zh: 沿用 SmartLingo 现有 Max 导师会话与 GPT-Live 网关，通过白名单关联本地人像资产和 OpenAI 声音名称。
新增 0195 增量迁移；已有导师会话默认 Mei/marin，后续更新会话不重置学生偏好。
将 Max 导师页加入手机、平板、横屏和桌面 WebKit 页面矩阵及登录保护检查。
en: Reuse existing SmartLingo Max tutor sessions and GPT-Live gateway with allowlisted local portrait assets and OpenAI voice names.
Add additive migration 0195; existing sessions default to Mei/marin and subsequent session updates preserve learner preferences.
Add the Max tutor page to phone, tablet, landscape and desktop WebKit layout and authentication checks.

zh: TypeScript、零警告 lint、完整测试、生产构建、D1 迁移重放、站点策略门禁及 WebKit 页面矩阵。
发布后用普通 Max 测试会员核对更换、保存、刷新、实时连接和结束重连，并核对精确 Project 发布记录。
en: TypeScript, zero-warning lint, full tests, production build, D1 migration replay, site-policy gates and WebKit layout matrix.
After deployment, verify selection, persistence, refresh, live connection and reconnect as an ordinary Max QA member, plus the exact Project release record.

zh: 不做真人摄像视频、音画唇形同步、自定义头像上传、付款或长时间并发语音负载测试。
en: No human camera video, lip-synced video, custom portrait upload, payment or prolonged concurrent voice load testing.

zh: 学习语言仍与站点辅助语言独立；切换回话语言由学习者明确提出，不能保证识别每种语言或每次都完全正确。
en: Learning and site-support languages remain separate; the learner may explicitly request a reply-language switch, but recognition across every language and every utterance is not guaranteed.

rollback.zh: 如需回退，先结束活动语音通话并部署前一版本；新增 D1 列保留，旧代码会忽略它们。
rollback.en: To roll back, end active voice calls and deploy the prior version; the additive D1 columns remain and are ignored by older code.
